final.scope: Class identities are reused from the earlier development study and are disjoint from the800fittingclasses and validation classes. They may overlap the new initial-quality-screen classes. Generation seeds are fresh; no unseen-pretraining-class or new-class-confirmation claim.

selection: Gate every candidate output using only the frozen quality metrics against its supplied marked source. Return the source on failure. Choose largest update budget then lowest anchor among candidates whose gated validation outputs all pass. No detector feedback. Freeze before fresh final seeds.
comparison: Each attacked checkpoint versus its own unmodified supplied checkpoint, same native generation seeds, labels and decoder. Report every candidate and failed-preservation sample. This is an output-gated hybrid client retaining the supplied source generator, not a single replaced checkpoint. It pays for both generation paths and quality evaluation. Gates are metric proxies, not proof of exact perceptual or semantic equivalence.
status: Frozen horizon500 revision: original/fixed/adapted models share the same blind500-update attacker, fallback, quality gates and selection rule. Existing fitting data and evaluation classes are reused with fresh generation seeds. Protocol frozen before any independent attack training or owner evaluation.
